items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And we heard Antonio Hart. [INTERVIEWER] Oh Antonio sounds great. [INTERVIEWEE] Well there’s some really terrific young players around.
